RETRAIN - queue precision decayed.watch: precision@50 on a human-audited sample of the shipped queue
RETRAIN - queue precision decayed.why: that is the hand-rule's score. Below it the model has stopped earning its place.

INVESTIGATE - precision moved but may be.why: 2 sd of the measured split-to-split spread; smaller moves are not signal.

RETRAIN - label drift.watch: portfolio share of pages labelled declining
RETRAIN - label drift.why: the base rate IS the bar; if it moves, every precision number changes meaning.

REVIEW - population drift.why: the model's strongest feature (ML-08 permutation importance). If its distribution shifts, the ranking rests on different ground.

REVIEW - new clients entered.watch: client count and the share of queue rows from unseen clients
REVIEW - new clients entered.trip_if: > 10% of queue rows come from clients absent at training (now 32 clients)
REVIEW - new clients entered.why: one held-out client scored 0.445 in ML-09. New clients are the known failure mode.

REBUILD - window rolled.watch: age of the 90-day snapshot the scores were computed from
REBUILD - window rolled.why: scores describe a fixed window; a third of it is stale after a month.
